title: Tree Search-Based Evolutionary Bandits for Protein Sequence Optimization
relevance: Core reference: tree search + bandit learning for protein engineering. Provides Bayesian regret bounds and compatibility with GP priors and pre-trained embeddings.
key_finding: Tree search with bandit guidance efficiently discovers near-optimal protein designs with provable Bayesian regret bounds.

title: Sample-efficient Antibody Design through Protein Language Model for Risk-aware Batch Bayesian Optimization
relevance: Risk-aware batch Bayesian optimization for antibody design using PLM embeddings. Demonstrates how bandit-like allocation can be combined with PLM scoring.
key_finding: Risk-aware batch BO achieves sample-efficient antibody design by balancing exploration and exploitation in PLM embedding space.

title: Toward real-world automated antibody design with combinatorial Bayesian optimization (AntBO)
relevance: AntBO uses combinatorial BO with trust regions. Demonstrates bandit-like position exploration in antibody CDR design achieving superior designs in <200 oracle calls.
key_finding: AntBO outperforms 6.9M experimentally tested CDRH3 sequences in under 200 calls using trust region-based combinatorial BO.
